snippet.description:
AIR 170 Abhijeet Jain visited LevelUp IAS and met his mentor, Karandeep Sir. He also conducted the 5-Hour Daily Study Plan workshop, sharing practical insights on managing UPSC preparation alongside college and a full-time job. Here's a glimpse of the workshop, the interaction with aspirants and the key questions discussed during the session.

Haven’t started your UPSC preparation yet?
Join our free 10-day bootcamp for UPSC beginners.
https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-aarambh/

Enrollment Open in GS Foundation Program for UPSC CSE 2028: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/

📲Queries? Call directly- 8826496658

Meet us 📍 at LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYEu8PA
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
